calls `[r8 vtable+0x48]`(`r8`, `rcx`) at `00830B40`+0x26, passes that result to `[r8 vtable+0x30]`(`r8`, it) (+0x35) and stores what it returns at qword `rdx+0`, calls `[r8 vtable+0x58]`(`r8`, first result) (+0x4A) when that stored value is non-null, copies dword `rcx+8` to dword `rdx+8`, and returns `01CCD380` "btCollisionShapeData"; consistent with btCollisionShape::serialize in Bullet (the returned struct name)

calls `[vtable+0x58]`(`rcx`) (`00830BB0`+0x18), then `[rdx vtable+0x18]`(`rdx`, that size sign-extended, 1) (+0x2A), then `[vtable+0x60]`(`rcx`, qword `+8` of the returned record, `rdx`) (+0x3E), and finally `[rdx vtable+0x20]`(`rdx`, the record, that result, 0x50414853 (the bytes 'SHAP'), `rcx`) (+0x59)

scales the float3 at `rdx` by the float3 at the fifth argument, scans the `r9d` 16-byte points at `r8` (four per step while at least four remain, then one by one) for the largest dot product with it, starting from the bound at `01CCD4E4` (raw `0xDD5E0B6B`) and index -1 and replacing only on a strictly greater value, then writes that point's x, y, z times the fifth-argument float3 to `rcx` with dword `+0xc` 0 and returns `rcx`

from the float3s A at `rcx+0x50` and B at `rcx+0x60` takes half-extents 0.5 (`01CEBB70`) x (B - A) plus the fifth (float) argument and centre 0.5 x (A + B), maps the centre through the 3x3 rows at `rdx+0`, `+0x10`, `+0x20` plus the float3 at `rdx+0x30`, takes the extents as the absolute row values (mask `01CEBD80`) times the half-extents, and stores centre minus extents as 16 bytes at `r8` and centre plus extents as 16 bytes at `r9`, both with a zero fourth float

copies the 16 bytes at `r8` and, when their squared x, y, z length is below `01CCD4E0` (raw `0x28800000`), replaces them with (-1, -1, -1, 0) from `00D7B290`; scales the vector by 1.0 (`01CEBBA8`) over the call at `00831230`+0x9D on its squared length, multiplies that unit vector by the float the call at +0xD1 returns for `rcx`, adds the float3 returned by `00831380`(rcx, stack out, unit vector) and stores the sum to `rdx` with dword `+0xc` 0, returning `rdx`

switches on dword `rcx+8` (0 to 0xd, through a table) and returns `rdx`; the arms: zero the 16 bytes at `rdx`; store the float3 at `rcx+0x30` with each component negated where `[r8]`'s is negative; store whichever 16-byte vertex at `rcx+0x50`, `+0x60` or `+0x70` has the largest dot product with `[r8]`; with axis k = dword `rcx+0x50`, store `rcx+0x30`[k] signed by `[r8]`'s k component on axis k and the other two components of `[r8]` times the lower other half-extent over their length (call at `00831380`+0x21B; that half-extent and 0 when the length is 0); normalize `[r8]` ((1, 0, 0) below 0.0001 `01CEBB60`) and keep, of the points ±`rcx+0x30`[k] on axis k each plus the unit vector times `rcx+0x30`[(k+2) mod 3] times the float3 `rcx+0x20` minus the unit vector times float `rcx+0x40`, the one with the larger dot product (start `01CCD4E4`); call `00830CD0`(rdx, r8, qword `+0x80`, dword `+0x88`, `rcx+0x20`) or `00830CD0`(rdx, r8, qword `+0x90`, dword `+0x84`, `rcx+0x20`); float3 stores carry a zero dword `+0xc`; above 0xd it calls `[vtable+0x78]`(rcx, rdx, r8) at +0x5CC

takes m = `[vtable+0x50]`(`rcx`) (call at `008319D0`+0x3A), then for each axis i of 0-2: maps the unit vector +e_i through the transpose of the 3x3 rows at `rdx`, calls `[vtable+0x70]`(rcx, stack out, it) at +0xF6, maps the returned point by the rows plus the float3 at `rdx+0x30` and stores its i component plus m to float i at `r9`; then does the same for -e_i (call at +0x222) and stores the i component minus m to float i at `r8`
stores the absolute values of the three floats at `rdx` (mask `01CEBD80`) with a zero fourth float as 16 bytes at `rcx+0x20`

makes the call at `00831D30`+0x9 with `rcx`, stores `01CCD620` at qword `rcx+0`, 1.0 (`0x3f800000`) at dwords `+0x50`, `+0x54` and `+0x58` (the last as a qword store that zeroes `+0x5c`), -1.0 (`0xbf800000`) at dwords `+0x60`, `+0x64` and `+0x68`, 0 at dword `+0x6c` and byte `+0x70`, and returns `rcx`

when `r9d` is positive, stores the raw `0xdd5e0b6b` at dword `+0xc` of each of the `r9d` 16-byte records at `r8`, then for each 16-byte vector at `rdx` loops i from 0 while i is below `[vtable+0xa0]`(`rcx`) (calls at `00831E80`+0x68 and +0xCD), fetches point i through `[vtable+0xb8]`(rcx, i, stack) (+0x7F) and, when its dot product with the vector exceeds the record's dword `+0xc`, copies the point's 16 bytes into the record and the dot product into its dword `+0xc`

takes m = `[vtable+0x50]`(`rcx`) (call at `00831F80`+0x35), calls `[vtable+8]`(rcx, an identity transform from `008C5F80`/`008C5F90`/`008C5FB0` and a zero row, stack min, stack max) at +0x7C, forms L = 2 x (0.5 (`01CEBB70`) x (max - min) + m) per axis and stores `xmm1` x 0.08333333 (`01CCD6F8`) times (Ly² + Lz², Lx² + Lz², Lx² + Ly²) with a zero fourth float as 16 bytes at `r8`; the frame is guarded by the cookie at `01F44830` (check call at +0x12D)
returns `00830F20`(rcx, rdx, r8, r9) with the fifth argument set to the float `[vtable+0x50]`(`rcx`) returns (call at `008320D0`+0x24)

sets byte `rcx+0x70` to 1, calls `[vtable+0x80]`(rcx, `01F44880`, six zeroed 16-byte stack records, 6) at `00832290`+0x5B, then with m = float `rcx+0x40` stores record 0's x + m at `+0x60`, record 1's y + m at `+0x64`, record 2's z + m at `+0x68`, record 3's x - m at `+0x50`, record 4's y - m at `+0x54` and record 5's z - m at `+0x58`; the frame is guarded by the cookie at `01F44830` (check call at +0xCC)
